thread:
Alex: Heads-up — planning a preflight for a min_replicas bump on the high-memory dedicated GPU pool tonight at 23:00 UTC. Target is increase min_replicas 2 -> 4 to reduce cold-start latency. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/2345
Priya: I can own the smoke and trigger if staging looks good. pinging @Alex to confirm roll window. :thumbsup:
Jamie: Quick ask — are we doing a canary slice or full cut? Need to know for metrics window and rollback plan.
Alex: Canary 10% for 30m, then full if no regressions. Manual promote. Priya will trigger canary + smoke.
Marco: Staging run passed with that autoscale config (ran two cycles). No OOMs observed. Heap and nvlink metrics look normal.
Priya: Copy. I'll run the smoke checklist 10m before and again during canary. Posting my checklist below.
Priya: ```
SMOKE CHECKS - high-memory pool minscale bump
1) deploy canary to 10% slice (rdeploy canary)
2) run quick gen test (curl /v1/generate health with long prompt)
3) validate KV cache hits don't regress (metrics: kv_cache_hit_ratio)
4) check qlen and tail latency (p95/p99 token latency)
5) confirm no OOM or evictions in node logs
```
Alex: Good. Add a step to confirm autoscaler controller logs don't show "scale rejected" errors.
Priya: Added. Also will validate billing token usage isn't spiking (sanity check).
Jamie: Which dashboards should we watch? I'll post links.
Jamie: GPU metrics: https://grafana/internal/d/GPUPool/high-memory
Jamie: Autoscaler logs: https://grafana/internal/d/AS/logs
Marco: SRE note: watch eviction_rate and node_pressure. If eviction_rate > 0.5% in 10m, abort and rollback.
SRE-Oncall: I'm on standby during the window. If you need immediate rollback, call me or tag here.
deploy-bot: Deployment queued by Priya for 2026-03-17T23:00:00Z. Canaries: 10% -> 100% (manual promote). Rollback command: `rdeploy rollback --pool high-memory-pool --to-revision {{previous_rev}}`
Priya: My rough timeline: 22:45 UTC — preflight checks, 23:00 — trigger canary, 23:30 — decision window, 23:40 — if green, promote; 23:50 — final verification.
Alex: Sounds good. Ownership: Priya = executor, Alex = primary monitor, Marco = staging validator, Jamie = metrics and dashboards.
Jamie: I'll set up an alert on p99_token_latency > 2s and gpu_util < 20% for the canary slice.
Priya: Quick sanity commands I'll run once canary is live:
```
# smoke: generate small and large prompt
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" \
  -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"model":"highmem-v1","prompt":"Hello"}'
# check pool queue
rbq get-queue high-memory-pool | head
# check pods and evictions
kubectl -n inference get pods -l pool=high-memory-pool -o wide
kubectl -n inference describe pod <pod> | grep -i eviction || true
```
Marco: If anything looks off, recommend immediate rollback. Use `rdeploy rollback` or `rdeploy promote --from-revision <old>` depending on deploy state.
Alex: Agreed. Post here when you start the canary and when you promote. If no messages by 23:45 I'll ping you.
Priya: Will do. Starting preflight in ~20m.
Alex: Thanks — :rocket:
Priya: Starting preflight checks now: running generate tests and kv cache smoke.
Priya: Preflight pass. No obvious regressions. Kicking off canary now.
deploy-bot: Canary started: high-memory-pool @ 10% (rev: ab12cd34 -> bc23de45).
Priya: Canary live. Running smoke again.
Jamie: Watching dashboards. GPU util at 78%, p99 token latency stable at 1.1s. kv_cache_hit_ratio flat.
Marco: No evictions. Logs look clean for the last 10m.
SRE-Oncall: No alerts triggered.
Priya: Canary smoke passed. Waiting 30m window to complete.
Alex: If the 30m window stays green, promote at 23:35.
Priya: Window green at 23:31. Promoting to 100% now.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete. high-memory-pool now at new min_replicas=4 (rev: bc23de45).
Priya: Post-promote checks running. No regressions so far.
Jamie: Adding a 2h watch on p99, evictions, and cost delta.
Marco: I'll follow up with a short postmortem note if anything odd surfaces.
Alex: Great job team. Leave this thread open for the next 2 hours for any late issues.
Priya: :thumbsup: closing if quiet by 01:45 UTC.
